text:
nora (Marketing): Quick one-pager draft for "Secure Launch Lite" 1-page summary + 1 benchmark slide + webinar hook + routing play. Need fast review so we can publish a short launch post and registration link.

eli (SRE): Nice structure. Please add a tiny ops note: default rollback = model-variant-fallback + cross-region failover. Also call out observability links.

cam (Field): Benchmarks we should show: Hosted p99 ~ 400ms (seq 384), Dedicated p99 ~ 85ms (seq 384), throughput ~130 req/s/GPU. Add short note about quantization and model family variance.

jess (Sales): Routing rules: tag inbound leads with {tier:enterprise, intent:private-deploy, compliance:yes}. Route to AE-enterprise, escalate to solutions if on-prem requested. Also ask for expected QPS on the lead form.

cam (Field): Two-line customer blurb for slide 1: "FinData piloted Redwood Private and met 99.95% uptime while cutting inference cost by 2.8x; pilot used dedicated GPUs in a VPC and retained full audit logs."

eli (SRE): Ops snippet for engineers (simple):
```yaml
fallback_policy: model_variant
failover: cross_region
observability: https://playbook.internal/obs/secure-launch
```

nora (Marketing): Webinar sketch: 30m total -> 6m market + 10m demo (deploy modes + console quick tour) + 10m benchmark walk-through + 4m live Q&A. CTA: request private trial. Jess will handle Q&A.

jess (Sales): I'll draft the landing copy and quick FAQ. One ask: include a demo checklist for field (VPN access, test dataset, expected tokens).

deploy-bot: Assets: /assets/secure-launch-lite/onepager-v1.pdf uploaded. Auto-schedule draft webinar slot for next Wed 10am PT (tentative).

nora (Marketing): Perfect. Two quick asks: (1) @eli confirm the observability link is public to field teams, (2) @cam can you double-check the Dedicated p99 number? If both good I'll publish a short launch post + send webinar invite. Thanks! :rocket:
